description.value: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar is a well-established Canadian steakhouse chain with a Kelowna outpost at the intersection of Highway 97 and Underhill Street, making it easy to reach from either the airport corridor or downtown. The location features a year-round heated and covered patio alongside a lounge, bar, and semi-private dining room. Touring cyclists rolling into Kelowna along the Highway 97 corridor will find it a convenient sit-down or takeout option with free parking on site.

address.value: 1825 Underhill Street, Kelowna, British Columbia, V1X 8G8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Kelowna Keg location confirms the address, provides a phone number absent from OSM, and lists several amenities explicitly: 'Free Parking', 'Free Wi-Fi', 'Takeout', a year-round heated/covered patio, and wheelchair accessibility. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or water refill is made anywhere in the website content. Takeout is confirmed via repeated 'Order Takeout' prompts and a dedicated amenity label on the location page.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number (778) 484-3810 sourced from website only — not cross-confirmed against OSM.
Address in OSM lacks postal code; website provides full address including V1X 8G8, used here.
National chain restaurant — no cycling-specific infrastructure (bike rack, pump, water refill) mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Keg is a legitimate food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists with confirmed takeout and free Wi-Fi, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed by the website. A field check to verify bike parking and water-refill availability is needed before including this listing.
